en: My debt to Oathkeeper will be paid.
I paid a terrible price for a second chance. And I would gladly pay it again.
Prepare yourself for what's to come.
Do you have the stomach to do what needs to be done?
I didn't sell my soul. I saved my life.
Oathkeeper doesn't need to be fed yet.
It's ok. I can control him a little longer.
I won't give in to Oathkeeper today.
I think you can handle this all on your own.
I wish I could help, but I have a gala to attend.
You're not seriously walking away from me, are you?
If you need me, I'll be at the Met.
If you need me, I'll be at the Met.
If you need me, I'll be at the Met.
I will suffer this indignity quietly. And when misfortune falls upon you, you will always wonder: "Was that fate? Or was that Lady Geist?"
And now I have to work alongside a brute.
It's a malevolent spirit. Nice book.
You look... remarkably calm for a lady that's about to get shot at.
If I thought we were dealing with anyone competent, maybe I'd be worried.
So you're calm because you're delusional?
Thank you for your help, Detective.
We still got a long way to go before we summon the Patron!
Abrams, if there's one thing I am confident in, it's getting what I want.
Remember: When we summon the Patron, we need to be very specific about what we ask for.
No going into business for yourself!
You're paired with a prodigy. You're welcome.
So, are you idly rich or do you actually do something of value?
You have no idea who you're talking to.
That's a curious piece of jewelry you have, Lady Geist.
Great. I'm stuck working with an automaton.
Ah ben super, maintenant je suis coincé avec un bourgeois. (Ha, great. I'm stuck with an upper-class.)
Apologies. I didn't realize I was working with a man of culture.
Geist. Are you doctor Johann's sister?
You're not one of those machines that value human life, are you?
Not particularly. Beyond a few... notable exceptions.
Wonderful. We'll get along just fine.
Not like you actually give a shit, but my name's Billy.
No self-respecting man actually wants to be called "Billy".
Oh, so now you know me.
Believe me, William. I wish I didn't.
When your ivory tower comes crashing down, I hope you're under it.
Be as snide as you like. At the end of the day, I'll be sleeping in my penthouse, and you'll be chewing on a tin can wondering where your life went wrong.
Oh, I know exactly where my life went wrong, lady.
Impressive. I'm sure you were spoiled for choice.
Yeah, well, maybe your life would be handled with a little more care if you didn't insult me.
You work at The Baroness, yes?
That hotel used to be magical, until its standards went to hell.
I will lodge your complaint with the management.
I hope you don’t expect a tip for helping me.
I wouldn’t dream of expecting anything from you, Lady Geist.
And how is Oathkeeper treating you these days?
You’re as charming as ever, Lady Geist.
I've never met you before in my life.
I was talking to your arm.
Oh, we go back a long ways.
Oathkeeper asked me to give you a message.
[Laughs] Oh, today is gonna be fun.
That ward's lookin' like it ain't lastin' much longer, Geist.
You gotta be scared as hell.
May I have a word, Professor?
Not sure what to do with that...
Find dignity, and a halfway decent tailor.
I'll see what I can do.
That binding ward is looking in rough shape.
A fact that I am keenly aware of.
I would have that looked at soon.
Thank you for your concern, Professor.
Yes... and very patient. Hopefully after the ritual, that patience will be rewarded.
Pleasure to see you again, Lady Geist.
Thank you for your help, Professor.
Thank you for the funding. I trust that your Oathkeeper situation has been resolved?
I would say, mitigated to my satisfaction.
You're a man of science, Professor. Do you think what they say about the Patrons is true?

Well, it's clear that the Patrons are beings of immense power... whether or not they actually intend to fulfill their end of the bargain is less about science and more about their nature. On the plus side: we're about to find out.
Are you related to Johann Geist?
He was really talented. I wrote a paper about him in Humanities.
"Verloren in die Stille" is amazing. (German: "Lost in the Silence")
The jacket kinda gives it away.
You know your arm's evil, right?
Like, he won't stop screaming about what he wants to do to people.
That ward on your arm. It's impressive.
I'm sure the Baxter Society would love to speak to whoever designed it.
You were a fool to make a deal with that thing.
If you were, I doubt you'd be risking your life right now.
You know... you're lucky. If the Baxter Society knew about your arrangement with Oathkeeper, they probably would have put you in the ground.
The Oathkeeper issue needs to be resolved, Lady Geist.
Good. If it's not, the OSIC will have to intervene.
As a general rule, I do my best to avoid state-sponsored assassins.
Assassins work in the private sector. When you're federally employed you're called an asset.
Don't worry, Lady Geist. I'm not here for you today.
It was a gift from my husband.
You know how to use it?
It looks like we're about to find out, aren't we?
I don't mean to be rude...
I'm relieved to know that you have eyes, Sheriff.
You've done some horrible things, and after I stop the Troubadour, I'm gonna find out what.
I'm assuming there will be a celebration at Jezebel's after we win?
He's nervous. The bar's not pulling in what it used to, and he's got a bunch of issues with the Alchemy Bureau.
Anything I can do to help?
At this moment, his two favorite hobbies are medicine, and being sanctimonious.
I never got to say thank you for you patronage, Lady Geist.
I'm serious! Obviously, the expedition didn't go as planned, but we wouldn't have had the opportunity were it not for your funding.
I don't know. But I intend to find out.
You seem to be short on friends, Lady Geist.
I don't need friends. That's what money is for.
That way of thinking is a fast path to a lonely life. You'll realize that when you're older.
Kelvin... believe me when I tell you that you have no idea what you're talking about.
Whatever happened to your friend that cause a scene at your fundraiser? His name was... Edward? Edgar, something like that?
I don't know. I tried to find him when I returned to New York, but... it's like he's vanished.
Well, he was rather rude. So I say "good riddance".
I wish I could share that sentiment.
Well, take a look at Green-Armed Sally.
That's fine by me, I'm just happy lookin'.
Whenever I decide to kill you, just remember it's because of this conversation.
Competent? No. I am god's gift to combat.
I can't tell if you're delusional or appropriately arrogant.
Now... what's a lady who's got everything need from the Patrons?
We're not friends, Lash. You don't keep my confidence.
They say comrades in arms build deeper relationships than lovers.
I don't know how you do it.
You'd be surprised what you're capable of when the only other option is death.
Oh, I wasn't talking about murder, I was talking about pretending to be interested in people at fundraisers. I've seen you work the room at Fairfax's parties, it's... somethin' else.
Oh. Johann dragged me to hundreds of those before. It's second nature.
Ugh. You smell of motor oil and labor.
That's because I work for a living!
Yeah, turns out being a human being is good for the soul. You should try it sometime.
Seriously, how do you think you're gonna fight in that?
Your concerns are as unwanted as they are unneeded. Watch and learn.
You remember what you need to do?
Collect souls, power gauntlet, summon Patron... live forever.
You know, that actually sounded sincere. Way to go, Lady Geist!
I've heard about you, Lady Geist.
Rumors are rarely kind to their subject.
When the ritual is complete, I'd love to have a chat with her.
But it is. When you decide that you wish to be forthright... let me know. And I'll consider your request.
Good help is hard to find. Nashala is lucky to have you.
It's an honor to serve her.
I can't believe I'm working with an oversized rat.
Apologies for saying the wrong rodent.
Lady Geist. For now, our purposes are aligned... but if you wish for that pretty arm of yours to remain attached after the ritual, I suggest you be kinder to Maurice.
That binding ward on your arm is... very impressive.
Whoever made it was an artist at their craft.
It's nice to meet you, Lady Geist!
"It" does. "It" also plays a critical role in your survival, so perhaps we should try that again: "It's nice to meet you, Lady Geist!"
I heard a rumor that you had one of my husband's paintings.
I wouldn't know, art's not really my thing.
I am not someone to play games with.
Lady, we already robbed you. You're exactly the person to play games with. If you want the painting back, I recommend that you try to find it. Good luck.
You know, I've been to the Paradox museum last Summer.
I found it cliché and overwrought.
It was a multi-million exhibition with the emotional depth of a 10th grader writing "I will rage against conformity" in a poetry unit of Remedial English.
It had a hellenistic bust of Homer!
How often does your little social club gather?
I'm assuming your ilk likes to brag about what they stole.
We're a bunch of bored rich people, of course we brag about what we stole.
I have one of those faces.
You were one of the urchins my foundation paraded around for good press, weren't you?
Who did you rob for that overcoat?
That jacket is a Kelsey Evans. There's no way someone like you could afford it. Who did you rob?
I see you're finally addressing your Oathkeeper problem.
What do you know about Oathkeeper?
I know that Faustian bargains rarely have happy endings.
I can't believe I'm about to be seen with a criminal.
I think public image is the least of your worries.
It's the only thing to worry about. If I die, I won't have to deal with the shame of associating with you.
Your pursuit of vanity is as pathetic as it is cliché.
Who do you think you are to speak to me like that?
After the ritual, would you like to have a drink?
I don’t know. Word on the street is that you’re a dangerous woman to know.
I'm a dangerous woman, whether you know me or not.
Jezebel's. Assuming the barman's not dead.
Let's not get ahead of ourselves.
How long have you been with the Baxter Society?
Oh great. I'm paired with a rank amateur.
Just try to keep up, Lady Geist. I’ll be accepting your apology later.
You managed to make a pompadour look attractive.
Wait 'til you see me stab somethin’.
Bet that dress costs more than my rent.
Y'know, I'm gonna let you have that one for free, that was a good one.
This might get a little bit messy for your delicate sensibilities.
I know fancy people like you don't like getting their hands dirty.
Geist, keep running your mouth and you'll be the prettiest little corpse on Manhattan. Well... second prettiest, Victor's got a lot goin' for him.
You certainly knew who to bribe.
When this is over, I'm cutting off your arm.
You can't fight evil with evil.
Why do you look so nervous?
Jeanne... Venators only hunt the wicked. What could you possibly have done to be worried about someone like me?
Well, aren't you a ghoulish creature?
You're a shambling mass of flesh. Why wouldn't I be?
My son's a doctor. You should speak to him.
Your condition is only going to worsen without someone to maintain you, and Johann is one of the best in New York. I'll introduce you when this ritual business is concluded.
Why are you being nice to me?
I don't know... but speak of it to no one! I have a reputation to uphold.
Are you ready to summon a god?
It's unbelievable. I was killed because people thought I was someone like you. Meanwhile, you're an actual monster, and you get to run around like the belle of the ball.
That's because I am the belle of the ball.
You're going to actually support me and not just fly away, right?
If you want help, all you have to do is ask.
This isn't the time to be smug. Both of our futures are at stake.
I don't have a nose, but if I did, I bet your hair would smell like flowers.
Hey, where can I get a pair of those earrings?
Why do you ask? It's not like you could afford them.
Okay, so it's sounding like "off your dead body".
Is that supposed to be a threat?
Lady, are you a moron? It's obviously a threat. After this ritual, I'm gonna mug the shit outta you.
My dear Vyper... I can't wait for you to try.
I can't believe I have to work with the likes of you.
What's the point? You are either going to die during the ritual, or die in a gutter shortly thereafter.
Cause I wanna marry into money. And like, wait five years and bump off my husband for the inheritance, cause this bird wasn't meant to be in a gilded cage, baby!
Then why are you fighting on their behalf?
You're a rather dour bastard, aren't you?
Boring people may say that I'm aloof, but at least I know how to have a good time! But you... you just look... perpetually miserable.
Don't worry about me, Warden. I know what's at stake.
You know what the difference between us is?
I worked for what I have. It wasn't handed to me.
Spoken with a conviction only true ignorance can bring.
That explains it. How long were you on his waitlist?
I had a marker on him, so not very long.
I don't suppose you have any moral issue with taking people out while they're helpless?
I think this will work out just fine.
Don't worry about me, Geist. Take care of yourself.
なんだその腕は？ (What's with your arm?)
Tu parles pas français, je parle pas japonais, mais on est quand même en train de se parler. (You don't speak French, I don't speak Japanese, but we're still talking to each other.)
I can cut the arm off.
If I'm to win, I must be willing to use Oathkeeper to his fullest potential!
Blood is but one path to power.
I may bleed... but they will die.
You won't walk away from this.
I paid the price, now die!
I'm flying close to the sun.
The lives of the weak are meant to sustain the lives of the strong.
No one's will is stronger than my own.
The smart will run. The foolish will die.
Today I don't have the luxury of mercy!
Life can only be bought with life.
This is not where I die.
Just need to last a little longer!
Pain is the price of victory.
They will be marked and they will die.
I spend life to take life.
My power comes at a cost.
My essence will slice through them!
I'll show them the strength of my resolve.
I will suffer... But they will die.
This is just a taste of what's to come.
It starts with a simple cut.
From here, only misery will follow.
I need to take the risk.
Ready to steal their life force!
When the time is right, I'll steal their health!
(Alt: When the time's right, I'll steal their health.)
Their health will belong to me!
Oathkeeper is ready to be fed!
When the time is right, they will be brought low.
There is no reward without risk.
Today, Oathkeeper receives his payment in spades.
Their life will sustain my own.
This can mean the difference between life, and death.
I'll lure them into my trap.
Life is nothing but a resource to be spent wisely.
You are not in control here!
It's not my time to die.
You have no idea what I'm capable of.
You were a fool to challenge us.
What is money when compared to the power of Oathkeeper?
And they thought they could escape me.
This is one of many victories to come!
The blood will flow down Broadway.
You were fools to fight me!
Live at my behest... Die at my whim.
I walk the line between life and death.
What do I have to fear from ants?
I won't be killed by the likes of you.
I have more tricks up my emerald sleeve!
I wonder what I can afford?
It's probably time to buy something new.
The money won't help me in my pocket.
My next purchase could change the battle.
I need to spend these souls.
I shouldn't leave money lying around.
Well! What do we have here?
Blood money spends as good as any coin.
Ahhh, the fruits of my labour.
Let the mediocre fight for scraps.
We got what we came for.
The ritual is one step closer.
Another part of the ritual complete.
When I find you, you will suffer.
They'll come back... and then they'll pay.
It takes someone better than that to kill me.
I know when it's time to leave a party.
I need to bide my time.
No sense in throwing my life away!
It's dangerous to be alone out here!
An ambush could come from anywhere!
I remain... As I always shall.
And once again... I am alone.
It's important to know when to back away.
Now is not the time for valor.
And now we make their lives hell.
They will press the advantage, and we must be ready!
I won't leave my allies to die!
I can't waste any more time at the base!
You're on your own for now!
I'll be back when I can.
I think I can still make the opera.
(Alt: hm! Finished in time to make the Wagner Tribute!)
I am perfection in all things!
My time has only just begun.
I always get what I want.
At last the ritual is complete!
Now to receive our blessing from the Patron!
Let's see what I have to work with today.
Not my choice for who I'd summon a god with, but the Patron wants what the Patron wants.
Soon I'll be free of you, Oathkeeper.
There is no cost I'm not willing to pay.
They will beg for mercy, and none will be given.
You were all surprisingly competent. Good job.
Yes, you were the help, but you were solid help.
Our lives are about to change for the better.
I always get what I want.
Let the guardian deal with that one.
Maybe they'll run out of bullets shooting William.
(Alt: Maybe they'll run out of bullets shooting William.)
They took out William with a regrettable goat head.
Hopefully he doesn't have a heart attack before he gets there.
I guess the arthritis hasn't set in after all?
Perhaps I shouldn't have judged him carrying a bow after all.
Talon certainly likes to cut it close.
I see Grey Talon has a flair for the dramatic.
I'll be with you soon, Haze.
I'd hate to be fighting her.
Holliday did her part. Now we need to do ours.
Fern, you are wasting your talents behind a bar.
See, Ivy? We can work together.
Don't fail me this time, Kelvin.
Cutting it a little close, aren't we?
Thanks for having my back, Kelvin.
It's like he came out of nowhere.
I don't care how useful she is, she annoys me.
I knew I could count on you, McGinnis!
Ugh! I can still smell the mole.
Don't get yourself into trouble, child.
That woman delights in causing chaos!
Pocket is off to do... whatever an urchin does.
That man is a glorious monster...
It's a pleasure watching you fight, Shiv.
They actually think they can stop Shiv? Adorable!
I'll be back when I can, Venator.
He looks more brooding than normal.
Well, this is a strange sensation.
Saved by a blob of goo. Hm.
Try not to die, Vyper. No one will miss you if you do.
That woman is impossible to have a conversation with.
You took the wrong case, Abrams.
The demon wasn't as strong as they thought they were.
And to think that, for a moment, I was worried.
What does it take to stop Abrams?!
The machine never had a chance.
Bebop was out of his depth.
Bebop is not a credible threat.
You didn't think that would stop me, did you?
You'll have to try harder than that, Bebop.
I took care of that ridiculous goat man.
I tire of your prattling, William.
Ugh, she reeked of new money.
Calico won't be bothering us for a while.
If you were more pleasant, maybe I would have given you a tip.
The Baroness is a shell of its past glory.
The Doorman is no one we need to be concerned with.
The Help often have... Delusions of grandeur.
What do I have to fear from a doorman?
If you're going to be a mass murderer, at least have some decorum.
And he thought I'd be easy prey.
I'm not afraid of you, Drifter.
You'll never get your body back.
You're never completing the ritual, Dynamo.
Look out for that black hole!
I remember when he was handsome.
Be grateful you lived this long, Grey Talon.
No one tries to hunt me.
I was hoping cholesterol would have done the work for me, but oh well.
Look out for the damn owl!
The government needs to stay out of my business.
Oathkeeper is not the OSIC's concern, Haze!
Perhaps Haze should have taken me more seriously.
There's no running from me, Haze.
You think I can't see you, Haze?
Your investigations have come to an end.
You traveled a long way just to die here.
New York isn't for you, my dear.
I'm sure you're somebody important in whatever irrelevant farm town you call "home."
Ugh, he was the only one who knew how to make a proper Gin and Tonic. Pity.
At least I don't have to tip him anymore.
Infernus is no longer a problem.
Stick behind the bar, darling. It's safer.
Sorry, Fern. I'll give you a nice tip tomorrow.
I can't have you stopping me, Infernus!
Ivy, Ivy, Ivy, when will you learn?
You're a glorified garden statue, know your place.
Stick to Spanish Harlem. Here, there are real monsters about.
Consider this the official removal of my funding.
How dare you oppose me, Kelvin!
Fighting for them?! After everything I have done for you?!
You can't run from me, Kelvin.
I won't be bullied by a stevedore.
The moustache is all that's impressive about you, Lash.
Lash was all talk. Surprise, surprise.
How could anyone idolize someone so crass?
For a moment, you almost looked heroic, Lash.
I could use someone with your intellect, McGinnis.
McGinnis, we've had amicable dealings before. Why throw your life away now?
I thought you were smarter than crossing me.
Looks like Fairfax Industries needs a new engineer.
This is what happens when you fight your betters, McGinnis.
Took out one of her turrets!
You need to pick better friends, Mina.
You're surrounding yourself with deplorable people, Mina.
She has my ambition... But not my talent, I'm afraid.
At least he was a gentleman.
I'll be washing the stench off me for weeks.
I bet Johann would like her.
Darling... This isn't the place for you.
You were a fool to oppose me.
She won't be shielding her friends for a while.
First my husband, now me. When will Paradox stay out of my life?
I've looked forward to this for quite some time.
You thought you were untouchable, didn't you, Paradox?
I've waited fifty years for this.
She thought she was so clever...
You didn't really think that would work, did you?
That little thief did it again.
Back to the gutter with you, Pocket!
Pocket is no threat to us!
You're a monster, Seven, and you got what you deserved.
You could only escape justice for so long, Seven.
I won't be another of your victims, Seven.
He was a handsome one, too!
Perhaps you should have taken me more seriously, Shiv.
You'll learn to respect your betters, Shiv.
I hate destroying beautiful things... oh well!
You made a mistake coming here, Venator.
It's time for you to leave New York, Venator.
His is a life hardly worth stealing.
Please, like you're the first person who's tried to assassinate me.
Vindicta's trying to pick us off!
And she thought she was safe.
I won't be defeated by a pile of goo!
I wonder if I could scoop some of him up for a moisturizer.
They won't be hiding in the cube any longer.
Bleed in a gutter where you belong, Vyper.
That cretin belongs in jail. Or the morgue.
The man fights like he's possessed!
I tire of your heroics, Warden.
You'll never be accepted in polite society, Wraith.
I expected more from you, Wraith.
You made a foolish mistake, Wraith.
Yamato is no longer a concern.
